features.cite: Zertal 2005 (Eng. Vol. 4) Site 115, pp. 348, 350; Fig. 230 p. 349
features.quote: six concentrations of rock-cut installations, among them basins

date.basis: entry assigns installations variously to Epipalaeolithic, IA and Rom-Byz without dating these basins

notes: f1 from the data block, not placed. f2: bare basins with no size, so pool_def unclear; the entry calls the site a centre for processing produce (wine and cereals) but does not call these basins winepress basins. Position W from p. 350: 'more than 60 installations ... in the western part of the spur' (the site); p. 348 also puts them 'West and south of the courtyards', and Fig. 230 shows the basins on the W/SW side. Plan not used to measure (unit point cannot be placed on it). Rock-cut 'craters' not coded (open hollows, type unclear, same W area). NE stone circle with central stone heap not called a burial; not coded.
